coordinate_policy: Coordinates are emitted only for exact or city display precision; city coordinates are coarse/approximate display points and no guessed point is substituted.
unknown_values: Blank or null means unknown or unavailable and is not an assertion of absence.

fields.name: facility_id
fields.description: Stable project facility identifier.

fields.name: canonical_name
fields.description: Project-normalized facility name.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Public city or region label, not a street address.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Release-ruleset classification category.

fields.name: display_precision
fields.description: Public location precision: exact, city, or unmapped.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Public latitude; null when not allowed by display precision.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Public longitude; null when not allowed by display precision.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description: Observed lifecycle label; disappearance is not closure.

fields.name: first_observed_at
fields.description: Earliest eligible observation in this release.

fields.name: last_observed_at
fields.description: Latest eligible observation in this release.

fields.name: observation_count
fields.description: Eligible observation count, not an animal count.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Evidence origin, separate from review and approval.

fields.name: factual_review_status
fields.description: Release-scoped factual review outcome or unreviewed state.

fields.name: privacy_screening_status
fields.description: Publication-safety screening outcome.

fields.name: project_approval
fields.description: Release/profile-scoped maintainer decision.

fields.name: reviewer_role
fields.description: Reviewer role label; no personal reviewer identity.

fields.name: publication_warning
fields.description: Persistent warning for community-unreviewed claims.

fields.name: publication_profile
fields.description: official, secondary, or community.

fields.name: release_id
fields.description: Immutable release identifier.

fields.name: release_ruleset_version
fields.description: Classification/projection ruleset identifier.

fields.name: provenance_source_id
fields.description: Stable source registry identifier.

fields.name: provenance_source_name
fields.description: Human-readable source name.

fields.name: provenance_source_url
fields.description: Official source URL recorded for provenance.

fields.name: provenance_retrieved_at
fields.description: UTC retrieval time for the source artifact.

fields.name: source_rights_status
fields.description: cleared or attribution_required; unknown/restricted rows are excluded.
